title: chipotle sauce

directions.step: Set the red bell peppers and tomatoes on a sheet tray and broil on high, flipping every few minutes, until charred on the outside. Finish with a blowtorch if you have one. The tomatoes will likely finish before the peppers. Place the tomatoes and peppers in separate metal bowls and cover with plastic wrap.

directions: After 10 minutes, uncover the tomatoes and remove the skins. Cut in half and remove the core. Do the same to the bell peppers.

directions.step: Add all ingredients except for the oil to a blender. Blend until smooth. While blending, slowly stream in the oil to emulsify. Stop adding the oil once emulsified and blend for 10 more seconds. Transfer to a container and store in the fridge.
